title: Node RPC invocation (frame 1) and reply
description: Read only after the fence passed. One QUIC bi-stream is one invocation: frame 1 is the context and the JSON-RPC 2.0 request; the reply is one JSON-RPC 2.0 response (or, for a streaming method, a sequence of length-prefixed response frames then FIN).

context.description: Observability only; never participates in dispatch or semantics. A part over its bound is dropped and the call continues (context_dropped names which).

caller_system.description: The originating system (rdm, rafka, node-admin), kept across a forwarded hop.

baggage.description: W3C Baggage, allowlisted keys only; anything else is dropped by name.

id.description: One stream is one invocation, so null is allowed; a caller that wants its own correlation names one.

method.description: The registered name of a call under the fence's op code in the op ledger. A method not registered under that op is refused by name (METHOD_NOT_UNDER_OP).

params.description: Named parameters only, per the method's OpenRPC schema. Never positional.

receiver.description: Who refused: the receiver names itself, so the caller's span carries both sides.

evict_connection.description: true only for STALE_TARGET: the connection reached the wrong node and is dropped.

x-errors.description: Gate errors are answered from the fence alone, before frame 1 is read. Every row carries data.receiver and the refused fence field verbatim.

rows.name: STALE_TARGET
rows.when: fence.target_node_id is not the receiver's id

rows.name: UNKNOWN_PORT
rows.when: fence.target_port is not a port this node serves

rows.name: UNSERVED_OP
rows.when: fence.op is not served on fence.target_port

rows.name: METHOD_NOT_UNDER_OP
rows.when: rpc.method is not registered under fence.op in the op ledger

rows.name: METHOD_NOT_FOUND
rows.when: the method name is unknown to the ledger

rows.name: INVALID_PARAMS
rows.when: params fail the method's schema, named by field
